--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,41 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Input must be numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrix")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match")
+    n, h = logp_with_result.shape
+    if n == 0 or h == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Matrix dimensions must be positive")
+    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError("Input contains non-finite values")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError("Input contains positive values")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not np.ndim(tau_filter) == 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be scalar")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute average log probability per token over the horizon for each candidate
+    avg_with = logp_with_result.mean(axis=-1)
+    avg_call = logp_call_only.mean(axis=-1)
+    avg_no = logp_no_call.mean(axis=-1)
+
+    # Improvement relative to the better baseline
+    improvement = avg_with - np.maximum(avg_call, avg_no)
+
+    # Keep candidates where improvement exceeds tau
+    mask = improvement > tau_filter
+    margins = improvement
+
+    return mask, margins
